tagline: The principles that shape how I ship, communicate, and own outcomes on a team.

principles.title: End-to-end ownership
principles.description: I take a feature from the database schema to deployed pixels — architecture, code, tests, billing, observability. That's one job, not three.

principles.title: Async-first, sync when it actually helps
principles.description: Default to written, asynchronous communication with good PR descriptions and notes-instead-of-meetings. I hop on a call when something truly demands one — never for status updates.

principles.title: Tests are part of the feature
principles.description: Coverage is a side-effect of writing good code, not a separate task. The SEO Operator platform ships with 51 tests covering every critical path; CI is the gate.

principles.title: Document the decision, not just the code
principles.description: // Why X over Y? beats // X. READMEs beat excuses. Pull-request descriptions are for humans, not auditors — explain tradeoffs, not just diffs.

principles.title: Ship the smallest viable change
principles.description: I bias toward the smallest thing we can ship and learn from, then refactor with intention when patterns actually repeat. No preemptive abstractions.

principles.title: Reaction 24h · Code mornings · Meetings afternoons
principles.description: Async messages: under 24h, every business day. PR reviews: same business day. Deep code work: mornings blocked out. Cross-team syncs clustered in the afternoon.
